on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  plan:
    steps:
      - run: terraform plan -no-color
caption: The computed diff, right in the PR, before merge.

eyebrow: A human approval gate before apply
code:
# .github/workflows/terraform-apply.yml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  apply:
    environment: production   # requires human approval
    steps:
      - run: terraform apply -auto-approve
caption: Merge doesn't mean apply — a person still says so.
